expressions.title: The Sind Electricity Control (Amendment) Act, 1949
expressions.title_basis: p1 block 1599256 prints 'ACT No. IV OF 1949 An Act to amend the Sind Electricity Control Act, 1947'; s.1(1) names it the Sind Electricity Control (Amendment) Act, 1949; ss.1-2 end the page (block 1599260). Blocks 1599241-1599247 (running head and the last rows 21-22 of a schedule table of an earlier law that began before this PDF) are a fragment and set aside as apparatus; block 1599255 is the margin note 'Sind Act III of 1947'.
